title: Marks (m, ')
instruction_text:
Marks let you jump instantly in large files!

KEY COMMANDS:
'm{a-z}' = set a mark at cursor position
''{mark} = jump to that mark's line (apostrophe + letter)
':marks' = list all marks

Your task: Jump to pre-set marks and delete the word FIXME!

We've placed 3 marks for you:
- Mark 'a' on line 5 (FIXME in the apple sentence)
- Mark 'b' on line 11 (FIXME in the banana sentence)
- Mark 'c' on line 17 (FIXME in the cherry sentence)

Steps:
1. Type 'a (apostrophe then a) to jump to mark a
2. Delete 'FIXME' by pressing daw
3. Type 'b to jump to mark b
4. Delete 'FIXME' by pressing daw
5. Type 'c to jump to mark c
6. Delete 'FIXME' by pressing daw
7. Save with :wq

Tip: Type :marks to see all marks anytime!
